choice: a head's latest review or fix carries the CI failure while it is queued or running, or while it is a finished review whose verdict is still due
why: SPEC T2 says a finished review carries the failure only while its verdict is still due; a verdict that already acted on another head must not hold back a ready at this head

choice: due until a trusted verdict naming the review's head and round, posted after the review's ready, is in handled_comments
why: job order cannot prove a verdict acted (r1 f-2): a poll snapshot can hide an already-posted verdict, and the newer job then let T2 split the fix

choice: a handled verdict counts whatever its outcome
why: approve-ci-red-fix, stale and over-cap verdicts never act again, so waiting on them would strand CI recovery

choice: the T2 fix key gains :after-<id> of the newest review or fix queued after the last fix at that head and generation
why: a second return to the same red head deduped onto the first finished fix and left nothing runnable (r1 f-1); a reposted ready with nothing in between still dedupes as before
